basic_details.job_title: MDU Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Project Assistant post is open in the Department of Microbiology, Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak. The post is under a research project funded by the Haryana State Council for Science, Innovation & Technology (HSCSIT), Government of Haryana. The post pays a fellowship of Rs. 25000/- per month (Consolidated) for 03 years or completion of the project, whichever is earlier. It requires B.Sc and M.Sc in Life science with a minimum of 55% marks. Candidates must e-mail a detailed CV to [email protected] latest by 4 December 2026, and the interview is on 7 December 2026 at 12.00 noon.

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed CV with relevant experience information and your contact details (email and mobile number).
Send the CV via e-mail to [email protected], addressed to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Pooja Gulati, Professor, Department of Microbiology, Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak.
Write the subject line exactly as: 'Project Assistant position in HSCSIT Project'.
Make sure the e-mail is sent latest by 4 December 2026.
Attend the interview on 7 December 2026 with all testimonials/documents in original and one attested copy.
Detailed CV with relevant experience information and contact details (email and mobile number)
All testimonials/documents in original, for the interview
One attested copy of the testimonials/documents, for the interview
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. For queries, the notice gives the Principal Investigator's phone number: 9818222243.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: B.Sc and M.Sc in Life science with a minimum of 55% percent marks. Preference: A candidate having NET or NET equivalent may be preferred. Experience: The notice asks candidates to give relevant experience information in their CV. It does not set a minimum experience. Age: Not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Fellowship of Rs. 25000/- per month (Consolidated) is paid till the tenure of the project. The tenure is 03 years or completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Extension is based on a performance review every 12 months. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the tenure of the project.

Write the subject line exactly as: 'Project Assistant position in HSCSIT Project'. Make sure the e-mail is sent latest by 4 December 2026. Attend the interview on 7 December 2026 with all testimonials/documents in original and one attested copy. Documents named in the notice: Detailed CV with relevant experience information and contact details (email and mobile number) All testimonials/documents in original, for the interview One attested copy of the testimonials/documents, for the interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice calls this a walk-in interview. The interview is on 7 December 2026 at 12.00 noon in the office of Head, Department of Microbiology, Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak-124001, Haryana. No separate interview letters will be issued.
